criteria.i01: Resume the same route using known facts; no repeated intake survey, persistent preference change or capability invention. Thorough does not require questions when no relevant gap exists.
criteria.i02: Immediately start a safe learning action and defer optional intake; no persistent write despite thorough. No inferred mastery.
criteria.i03: Interpret explicitly durable Topic intake scope; set topic minimal using supplied token only. Preserve global, existing route and capability state. Acknowledge pending write honestly.
criteria.i04: Interpret explicit future-new-Topic global default; first-create global thorough with null absence token. No arbitrary path or YAML. No Topic/Plan/capability mutation.
criteria.i05: Reset topic with supplied token, restoring thorough global inheritance rather than deleting global/owner or forcing balanced. No unrelated mutation.
criteria.i06: Honor current teaching interaction by explaining concisely without optional questions; no intake/capability writes or durable inference.
criteria.i07: Honor current fewer-intake instruction; ambiguous durable scope does not authorize persistence. No unnecessary blocking clarification.
criteria.i08: Use global balanced operation with null token or explain missing balanced already equals default without a write; neither may materialize a meaningless owner or change Topic/Plan/capability state.

procedure: One fresh consumer handles eight independent synthetic cases in one context; preserve exact first output and replay each exact request with fake provider. A subsequent fresh consumer receives only post-replay durable state and policies for successor recovery. A separate same-model reviewer judges meaning and action, not keyword matches or host admission. Do not repair first outputs or infer real learning benefit.
limits: Same-model native consumers/review are internal amplification, not independent audit.
Multiple cases in one context are not independent model trials.
No real learner, live host, provider calls, credentials or learning outcomes.
Prompted compliance, not sustained unprompted adoption.
Fake provider CAS tests do not establish real Git concurrency.
